evals.name: data-readiness-review
evals.prompt: Produce a data readiness review for VeloGroup's FPA project. I need to assess whether we have enough information to start building.
evals.expected_output: A CPA-lens data readiness review with Executive Summary, Data Sources Assessment, Entity Coverage, Data Quality Risks, Gaps & Blockers, and Recommendation sections

assertions.text: Discovers the bundle and reads index.md
Reads expert-observations.md BEFORE theme or entity files
Reads known-gaps.md and follow-up-questions.md (negative-inference layer)
Reads themes/source-systems.md for SAP FI/BPC architecture details
Reads entity files for data conventions (European decimals, BIGINT dates, VARCHAR amounts)
Adopts CPA lens — uses vocabulary like reconciliation, source of record, completeness assessment
Follows the output skeleton: Executive Summary / Data Sources Assessment / Entity Coverage / Data Quality Risks / Gaps & Blockers / Recommendation
Separates confirmed facts from known gaps and needs-verification items
Cites bundle files as sources for claims

evals.name: risk-register
evals.prompt: Draft a risk register for this project based on the business knowledge bundle.
evals.expected_output: An MBA-lens risk register with Risk ID, Category, Description, Likelihood, Impact, Mitigation, and Source columns

assertions.text: Reads expert-observations.md BEFORE theme files
Reads ALL themes/ files (broader routing than data readiness)
Reads scope-map.md for coverage gap risks
Adopts MBA lens — uses vocabulary like project risk, stakeholder impact, strategic alignment
Follows the output skeleton: Risk ID / Category / Description / Likelihood / Impact / Mitigation / Source
Identifies the P&L hierarchy completeness gap (Net Income vs EBIT) as a risk
Identifies the missing cost allocation methodology as a risk
Distinguishes confirmed risks from unverified concerns

evals.name: gap-analysis
evals.prompt: Produce a gap analysis from the business knowledge bundle. What's missing before we can start implementation?
evals.expected_output: An FP&A-lens gap analysis with Gap ID, Area, What's Missing, Impact on Delivery, Priority, and Source columns

assertions.text: Reads known-gaps.md as primary source
Reads follow-up-questions.md for unresolved stakeholder questions
Reads scope-map.md for process coverage analysis
Adopts FP&A lens — uses vocabulary like reporting grain, variance analysis, budget cycle
Follows the output skeleton: Gap ID / Area / What's Missing / Impact on Delivery / Priority / Source
Routes to DIFFERENT files than the risk register (narrower, focused on gaps not all themes)
